system.summary: Clear Swedish with two-digit letter codes, four-digit nomenclator codes (1328, 1504, 3143, 3192, 3319 ...) and letter-pair codes (rr, mm, aa, tt); some groups glossed between the lines at the time.
system.notes: Whether the four letters share one code is not established. The key collection lists a key 'Oxenstierna and Lars Nilsson Tungel (1633)', not identified among the 70 key records fetched. DECODE dates the records 1646; the leaves are dated 8/18 and 27 June 1633. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from riksarkivet1628 (catalogue 207).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched the 14 DECODE records of catalogue 207 with the project cookie; R4338-R4341 (Oxenstiernska samlingen E 708) are Swedish letters to Oxenstierna dated June 1633 (DECODE: 1646), mostly clear with numerical codes, part deciphered between the lines at the time. Surveyed only.

Split from the former catalogue-207 group entry riksarkivet1628 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026); E 708 is another correspondence and code. Image 1 of R4338 viewed again (codes 1328, 1504, 3143, 3192, 3597 with interlinear glosses). Not transcribed, not attacked.

outcome.method_basis: Surveyed only: the four letters were opened and their code noted, but the codes and the interlinear decipherments were not transcribed or used.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No transcription; no group read here (some glossed at the time).

gaps.detail: surveyed only; the interlinear decipherments of the time are unused; the Tungel 1633 key not identified among the 70 fetched key records
